hooks.command:
# 防止在 main branch 上編輯
[ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "不能直接修改 main branch。請先建立 feature branch。"}' >&2; exit 2; }

# 使用 Prettier（或 Biome）自動格式化 JS/TS files
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  file_path="${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH}"
  # 使用 prettier（偏好 biome 時可替換）
  npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>&1
  exit_code=$?
  if [ $exit_code -ne 0 ]; then
    echo '{"feedback": "格式化失敗。請檢查檔案是否有 syntax error。"}' >&2
    exit 1
  else
    echo '{"feedback": "已套用格式化。", "suppressOutput": true}'
  fi
fi

# package.json 變更時自動安裝 dependencies
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ package\.json$ ]]; then
  echo '{"feedback": "正在安裝 dependencies..."}' >&2
  npm install >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"feedback": "Dependencies 已安裝。", "suppressOutput": true}' || {
    echo '{"feedback": "Dependencies 安裝失敗。"}' >&2
    exit 1
  }
fi

# test files 變更時自動執行 tests
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.test\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  echo '{"feedback": "正在執行 tests..."}' >&2
  npm test -- --findRelatedTests "${CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH}" --passWithNoTests 2>&1 | tail -30
  exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
  if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
    echo '{"feedback": "Tests 通過。"}'
  else
    echo '{"feedback": "Tests 失敗，請查看上方輸出。"}' >&2
  fi
fi

# Type-check TypeScript files
if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(ts|tsx)$ ]]; then
  echo '{"feedback": "正在檢查 TypeScript types..."}' >&2
  output=$(npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1)
  exit_code=$?
  if [ $exit_code -eq 0 ]; then
    echo '{"feedback": "沒有 TypeScript errors。", "suppressOutput": true}'
  else
    errors=$(echo "$output" | grep -A 2 "error TS" | head -30)
    if [ -n "$errors" ]; then
      echo '{"feedback": "TypeScript 發現 type errors："}' >&2
      echo "$errors" >&2
    fi
  fi
  # 不阻塞
  exit 0
fi
